creator: Alexander Terp
description:
From the tooling feedback hub (a_2x15qRGGf), codex-cli 0.167.0 on a devenv, Muster 0.24.0.

`muster pane send --pane <it> "/new" --enter --confirm` opened a dialog mid-session: "Where should the new conversation run? 1. Use current Git worktree 2. Create new Git worktree ... enter select · esc back". `muster pane wait --until idle` returned at once with `done`, and `muster window` showed the pane done, though Codex was waiting on the dialog and would not take a posted message. Only `muster pane read` showed it. 0.15.0 made Codex's pre-session screens read blocked (a_2die6kvWY); this dialog comes after the session started.

Wanted: recognize Codex's in-session selection dialogs (this one's "enter select · esc back" footer) as blocked, so `--until idle,blocked` and helper notices report it.
title: Codex at its /new worktree dialog reads done, not blocked
